additional_info.subject: ID0477745-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R4 170001763] Error on LEM DC Meter CRM:03289000524
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
The logs for
DC4
and the other outlets confirm that the
Electric Vehicle (EV) stopped requesting energy
. As shown in the attached screenshot, the
Target Current
from the vehicle dropped to zero, causing the charger to terminate the session as there was no longer a demand to charge.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
